metadata.description: Architecture for Swift server backends: gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird gateway, typed-throws use cases in a Core target, adapters per technology, and executable composition roots.

plugins.name: swift-backend-architect
plugins.description: Architects Swift server backends as gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird API gateway, each service one Swift package with a Core target of domain models, repository protocols and typed-throws use cases, adapter targets for Postgres, gRPC, Temporal and Valkey, and an executable composition root on swift-configuration and swift-service-lifecycle, secured with mTLS, JWTs and Postgres row-level security through the swift-microservices libraries. Use when planning a backend or splitting it into services, designing a module map or Package.swift, writing use cases, repositories, gRPC services, Hummingbird routes and request contexts, Temporal workflows or a composition root, naming Swift server types and targets, adopting strict concurrency or FoundationEssentials, or reviewing a Swift backend's architecture or code style, even when the user doesn't name the architecture.
